## Part 361

- [Migrate thread methods to SmithDB](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/smithdb-sdk-migration-threads.md): These methods query threads and list the traces inside a thread.
- [Migrate trace methods to SmithDB](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/smithdb-sdk-migration-traces.md): These methods query traces and list the runs inside a trace.
